title: T1499 — Endpoint Denial of Service
subtitle: This animation shows a small flood attack from both sides at once.

steps.title: Recon probe
steps.caption: The attacker sends one normal-looking HTTP GET request to the target web server. The server answers in a few milliseconds. The SOC traffic graph sits at its usual baseline - the normal measured level of traffic - and no alert fires
steps.defender: EDR and Sysmon record the process, memory and image-load events. Correlate them with the parent process.
